title: Seoul to continue taking necessary measures based on 'clear principles' over DMZ: Wi
caption:
After a DMZ mine blast wounded three soldiers, South Korea announced it will stick to clear‑grounded policies. The government stresses a push for peace that makes fighting unnecessary while maintaining a defensive stance. No new troops or weapons were detailed.

Source: En - Seoul to continue taking necessary measures based on 'clear principles' over DMZ: Wi
